name: NOVELTY
description: Evidence-governed adversarial verification rather than another single simulator or unsupported quantum advantage claim; plane-separated provenance linking operational and scientific claims without evidence substitution.
acceptance_criteria: ≥3 materially different classical attack families specified
≥1 nontrivial benchmark or analysis contribution (finite-sample coverage estimator critique)
verification_method: Prior art comparison against standalone simulators
Cryptographic verification of cross-plane non-substitution schema

name: FEASIBILITY
description: Demonstration that OSIRIS/LivLM infrastructure can execute the declared intent-to-evidence pipeline end-to-end prior to any scarce physical QPU consumption.
acceptance_criteria: 100% of local governance test suite passes cleanly (65/65 PASS)
Zero adapter execution without cryptographic permit
Pre-QPU dry-run completed on Aer statevector reference
verification_method: Execution gate mode and least privilege audit

name: VALIDATION_RIGOR
description: Claims are subjected to adversarial rather than confirmatory testing across frozen protocols, independent classical simulation methods, preregistered metrics, and adverse-first adjudication.
acceptance_criteria: ≥3 classical attack families evaluated against candidate quantum circuit
Mandatory coverage-adjusted entropy estimators applied when sample coverage C < 0.1
Explicit SUPPORTED / REFUTED / INCONCLUSIVE disposition per claim
verification_method: Adversarial ladder execution and error metric boundary audit
Coverage-adjusted variance test refuting plug-in entropy

name: RESOURCE_USE
description: Transparent accounting of classical CPU/GPU compute, memory, and QPU shots; classical methods evaluated against explicit resource envelopes rather than unconstrained failure.
acceptance_criteria: Machine-readable resource ledger recording cpu_hours, gpu_hours, peak_memory, and shots
QPU campaigns strictly gated on pre-registered circuit manifests
verification_method: Inspection of execution receipts and resource logs
Empirical runtime and memory scaling curves vs problem size

name: REPRODUCIBILITY
description: Every published claim is reconstructable from immutable artifacts: commit, artifact digest, environment, raw data, analysis code, and cross-plane lineage.
acceptance_criteria: 100% of claims bound to immutable content SHA-256 digests
verification_method: Clean-room git clone and pytest run
